name: Administration Building
description: The central administrative powerhouse of the University of Hyderabad, housing the Vice Chancellor's office, registrar, and academic administration.
trivia: Often one of the first official stops for newly admitted students during registration and document verification.

name: SBI Branch & ATM
description: The on-campus State Bank of India branch, serving students, scholars, and faculty with banking and stipend services.
trivia: Lineups here are a campus tradition during stipend dispersal weeks.

name: Health Centre
description: Round-the-clock primary healthcare, pharmacy, and medical consultation facility for campus residents.
trivia: Equipped with round-the-clock emergency medical response and free doctor consultations for students.

name: Shopping Complex (North)
description: Hub of stationery stores, photocopy shops, tailor, and fruit stalls in the North campus area.
trivia: A lifesaver for last-minute assignment printouts and spiral bindings.

name: Tomato Genomics Facility
description: Pioneering plant genomics research centre focusing on tomato functional genomics and crop improvement.
trivia: Home to high-tech climate-controlled greenhouses and specialized plant transformation labs.

name: Science Complex
description: Sprawling multi-wing complex housing various core science departments, laboratories, and lecture halls.
trivia: One of the most architecturally prominent interdisciplinary research centers on campus.

name: UPE Lecture Hall Complex
description: University with Potential for Excellence modern lecture complex hosting common interdisciplinary courses.
trivia: Equipped with multimedia projection and smart auditorium acoustics.

name: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Lecture Hall
description: Named after India's renowned philosopher and second President Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, hosting large lectures.
trivia: Regularly used for keynote addresses, symposiums, and university orientations.

name: Student Centre
description: Focal point for student union activities, club meetups, cultural societies, and debate forums.
trivia: The vibrant heartbeat of campus democracy and cultural rehearsals.

name: School of Computer Science & Information Sciences
description: Premier department for AI, machine learning, systems, cyber security, and high-performance computing.
trivia: Features high-end computing clusters and round-the-clock labs where legendary hackathons take place.

name: DST Auditorium
description: State-of-the-art auditorium established with Department of Science & Technology support.
trivia: Acoustically tuned for international academic conventions, national science summits, and theatre festivals.

name: Indira Gandhi Memorial Library
description: One of India's largest and most comprehensive university libraries, holding over 400,000 volumes and digital archives.
trivia: Features 24/7 reading halls, high-speed Wi-Fi, and cool quiet corridors that become sanctuary during end-semester exams.

name: AMDISA
description: Association of Management Development Institutions in South Asia headquarters.
trivia: Fosters management education collaboration across SAARC nations.

name: Centre for Folk Culture Studies
description: Preserving, archiving, and researching India's rich tribal folklore, oral literature, and folk traditions.
trivia: Houses an ethnographic museum with authentic folk musical instruments, puppetry, and mask collections.

name: School of Management Studies
description: Hub of MBA programs in General Management, Healthcare & Hospital Management, and Business Analytics.
trivia: Regularly hosts corporate case study summits and entrepreneurship bootcamps.

name: School of Social Sciences
description: Comprising departments of History, Political Science, Sociology, Anthropology, and Economics.
trivia: Known for vibrant intellectual debates and critical scholarship across socio-political disciplines.

name: Ambedkar Lecture Hall
description: Centrally located lecture theater named after Dr. B. R. Ambedkar.
trivia: A favorite gathering spot for student academic discussions and guest lectures.

name: Central Instruments Laboratory
description: Houses state-of-the-art analytical equipment including NMR spectrometers, SEM, TEM, and Mass Spectrometers.
trivia: Serves researchers across Chemistry, Physics, Life Sciences, and Materials Science nationwide.

name: Open Air Theatre (OAT)
description: Iconic tiered amphitheater where university cultural fests, Sukoon, movie screenings, and drama plays take place.
trivia: Under a starlit Hyderabad sky, the OAT reverberates with music, dance, and cultural unity.

name: Electronics Building
description: Dedicated to microelectronics, semiconductor devices, VLSI design, and optical communications.
trivia: Equipped with specialized clean-room workstations for precision micro-fabrication.

name: Dept of Sanskrit & ELTC
description: Houses the Department of Sanskrit Studies and the English Language Teaching Cell.
trivia: Fosters computational linguistics alongside traditional classical Indian knowledge systems.

name: School of Humanities
description: Center for literature, philosophy, linguistics, and diverse Indian and foreign languages.
trivia: Its lush garden courtyard is a beloved spot for poetry circles and philosophical musings.

name: VC's Lodge
description: Official residence of the Vice Chancellor of the University of Hyderabad, nestled amidst green groves.
trivia: Surrounded by ancient banyan trees and peaceful campus flora.

name: Women's Hostel Complex (North)
description: Residential hostel cluster for women scholars and postgraduates with secure inner courtyards.
trivia: Known for peaceful study gardens and vibrant festival celebrations.

name: Teachers Flats
description: Residential apartments accommodating university faculty members and researchers.
trivia: Quiet tree-lined avenues with blooming bougainvillea.

name: Old SIP Guest House
description: Guest lodging originally established for visiting international scholars in the Study in India Programme.
trivia: Comfortable heritage guesthouse surrounded by rock greenery.

name: Zakir Complex & Food Court
description: Famous student culinary and social nerve centre. Sells piping hot Irani chai, samosas, dosas, and fresh juices.
trivia: The epicentre of student conversations, political analyses, and tea breaks between classes.

name: Networking Hostel
description: Hostel providing accommodation to students engaged in research and academic network initiatives.
trivia: Located right near the scenic eastern nature ridges.

name: STP (Sewage Treatment Plant)
description: Campus eco-friendly water recycling and treatment unit supporting campus green irrigation.
trivia: Helps maintain UoH's commitment to water conservation and zero runoff.

name: School of Sarojini Naidu Arts & Communication
description: Centre for Theatre Arts, Dance, Fine Arts, and Communication Studies.
trivia: You can frequently hear tabla rhythms, theatre monologues, and film camera buzz around here.

name: School of Chemistry
description: Renowned School of Chemistry recognized internationally for synthetic, physical, and computational chemistry.
trivia: A high-ranking research powerhouse producing notable breakthroughs in green catalytic chemistry.

name: C R Rao Institute (AIMSCS)
description: C.R. Rao Advanced Institute of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science.
trivia: Founded in honor of the legendary mathematician and statistician Prof. C.R. Rao.

name: B S L-III Facility
description: High-containment Bio-Safety Level 3 laboratory for infectious pathogen research.
trivia: Features negative-pressure airflow systems and strict biocontainment protocols.

name: Institute of Life Sciences (ILS)
description: Autonomous non-profit institute fostering innovative therapeutics and disease biology research.
trivia: Collaborates with global pharma leaders on novel drug discovery pipelines.

name: CMSD
description: Centre for Modelling Simulation and Design high-performance supercomputing facility.
trivia: Houses massively parallel supercomputing nodes for molecular dynamics and climate simulations.

name: Faculty Quarters (North-East)
description: Spacious residential enclaves (Type 36A & 36B) housing university professors and their families.
trivia: Known for quiet tree-canopied lanes and visiting spotted deer.

name: Football Ground
description: Full-size lush green football pitch where inter-departmental tournaments and evening matches take place.
trivia: Hosts thrilling annual Vice-Chancellor's Cup soccer playoffs under sunset skies.

name: Tennis Court
description: Synthetic hardcourt tennis facility with floodlights for evening student games.
trivia: Popular with morning fitness buffs and campus tennis champions.

name: Yoga Centre
description: Peaceful indoor hall dedicated to daily pranayama, asana training, and mindfulness meditation.
trivia: Open for dawn wellness sessions to start your study day in tranquility.

name: Faculty Centre
description: Recreational and social centre for campus faculty and staff.
trivia: Features reading rooms and indoor board game spaces for professors.

name: Child Care Centre
description: Campus daycare and early learning facility supporting university working parents.
trivia: Includes vibrant outdoor playgrounds and creative art corners.

name: Megalithic Site
description: Prehistoric Iron Age megalithic stone circle burrows and cairn packings dating back over 2,500 years.
trivia: Proof that human settlements flourished across this rocky Deccan terrain long before modern times!

name: Pariksha Bhavan
description: The Controller of Examinations building, managing semester grading, schedules, and convocation degrees.
trivia: The site where students collect their hard-earned degree certificates and transcripts.

name: Annex Hostel
description: Postgraduate student hostel located in the northern residential sector.
trivia: Quiet residential quarters with easy walking access to the main administrative zone.

name: Men's Hostels (A, B, C, D)
description: Historic multi-block student residence complexes (MH-A, MH-B, MH-C, MH-D) with bustling mess halls.
trivia: The birthplace of legendary campus debates and midnight study groups.

name: NRS Hostel
description: Non-Resident Scholars & research hostel block.
trivia: A favorite dwelling for dedicated PhD candidates immersed in thesis writing.

name: UoH Stadium
description: The main athletics stadium with a 400m running track, pavilion seating, and cricket ground.
trivia: The venue for annual university athletics meets and inter-university tournaments.

name: Gymnasium
description: Fitness centre with weight training equipment, cardio machines, and indoor badminton courts.
trivia: Equipped with state-of-the-art powerlifting and resistance training gear.

name: SAAP Shooting Range
description: Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh international-standard target shooting range.
trivia: Has trained national shooting champions in 10m air rifle and air pistol disciplines.

name: Staff Quarters (50A, 50B, 50C)
description: Residential quarters for non-teaching and support staff members.
trivia: Quiet family residential area nestled near the western buffer zone.

name: Campus School / Kendriya Vidyalaya
description: Kendriya Vidyalaya school inside UoH campus catering to children of faculty and local residents.
trivia: Features lovely morning school assembly hymns that echo gently across the nearby woods.

name: Academic Staff College & Medical Sciences
description: Human Resource Development Centre and School of Medical Sciences.
trivia: Hosts refresher courses and pedagogy development workshops for professors nationwide.

name: Gurubaksh Singh Maidan
description: Spacious open sports ground used for cricket matches, flying kites, and student festivals.
trivia: A great spot to watch the sunset against the campus horizon.

name: Lake View Guest House
description: Scenic university VIP guest house overlooking the tranquil waters of Gundla Kunta lake.
trivia: Has hosted Nobel laureates, visiting international delegates, and eminent scholars.

name: Campus Post Office
description: Official Department of Posts campus branch with pincode 500046.
trivia: Sends and receives books, research papers, speed posts, and letters from around the globe.

name: Hostel G
description: Postgraduate men's hostel with lively sports enthusiasts.
trivia: Located right next to the Central Workshop and student common amenities.

name: Gurubaksh Singh Hall
description: Named after UoH's first Vice Chancellor Prof. Gurbakhsh Singh.
trivia: Commemorates the founding vision of the University of Hyderabad in 1974.

name: Central Workshop
description: Precision mechanical, glassblowing, and electrical instrumentation workshop.
trivia: Custom-fabricates experimental scientific apparatus and glass vacuum lines for laboratories.

name: Hostel F
description: A historic residential hostel on the pathway heading toward South Campus.
trivia: Surrounded by neem trees and quiet reading balconies.

name: Chief Warden's Office
description: Central administrative office overseeing hostel admissions, mess facilities, and student welfare.
trivia: Where room allotments and hostel certificates are coordinated.

name: Automobile Workshop
description: University vehicle fleet maintenance and transport pool depot.
trivia: Maintains the campus electric shuttles and official university buses.

name: Faculty Quarters (South)
description: Southern sector residential homes for faculty and researchers.
trivia: Lush and secluded, adjoining the South campus wildlife trails.

name: South Campus ATM
description: Automated teller machine serving students in the south hostel zone.
trivia: Provides 24/7 cash withdrawals for late-night canteen snacks.

name: Tagore International House & ISH
description: Residence accommodating international scholars and foreign exchange researchers from over 30 nations.
trivia: A culturally vibrant global village on campus with international festivals and culinary nights.

name: Men's Hostel J
description: Postgraduate and research scholar men's hostel in South Campus.
trivia: Surrounded by breezy neem trees and scenic courtyard pathways.

name: Men's Hostel L & I
description: Spacious men's residence halls on the west side of SLS Road.
trivia: Located right across from the South campus volleyball court.

name: MHK Hostel (Hostels L & M)
description: Maulana Hasrat Mohani (MHK) Hostel. The player's home base on campus! Contains your cozy dorm room.
trivia: You can sleep here in your room to advance time, recover stamina, and save your game.

name: Ladies Hostel 7 & 8
description: Southern campus ladies' residence with garden walkways and reading verandas.
trivia: Directly accessible from the South Gate III avenue.

name: South Shopping Complex & Night Canteen
description: Famous night canteen hub! Opens at night with hot chai, Maggi, egg rolls, and social vibes.
trivia: After 10 PM, this place turns into an energetic hub of students relaxing, chatting, and enjoying music.

name: Centre for Integrated Studies (CIS)
description: Houses UoH's flagship 5-Year Integrated Master's Programs (Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences).
trivia: Filled with enthusiastic undergraduate scholars starting their university journeys.

name: Study in India Program (SIP)
description: International student center offering specialized semester-abroad courses in Indian heritage, arts, and languages.
trivia: A premier gateway for international scholars exploring Indian culture and academia.

name: Green House & Botanical Reserve
description: Botanical conservatory housing medicinal herbs, rare tropical flora, and experimental flora.
trivia: Maintains climate chambers for plant tissue culture and botanical conservation.

name: School of Life Sciences (SLS) & ASPIRE-BioNEST
description: World-renowned concentric circular research complex housing Biochemistry, Plant Sciences, Biotechnology, and the ASPIRE-BioNEST incubator.
trivia: Famous for its magnificent circular architectural wings with central courtyard botanical gardens.

name: Centre for Nano Technology
description: Interdisciplinary research facility for nanoscale materials, quantum dots, and biosensors.
trivia: Engineers cutting-edge nano-coatings and targeted drug delivery systems.

name: ACRHEM Research Center
description: Advanced Centre of Research in High Energy Materials, established jointly with DRDO.
trivia: A premier research powerhouse working on energetic materials and laser spectroscopy.

name: Mushroom Rock
description: A breathtaking billion-year-old natural monolithic granite balancing rock shaped like a giant mushroom. A protected National Heritage landmark!
trivia: One of Hyderabad's most iconic natural geological marvels, formed by millions of years of wind and water weathering.

name: Gundla Kunta Lake
description: The picturesque central lake of UoH, with waterfront trails, lotus patches, and migratory water birds.
trivia: A tranquil haven where students walk to de-stress, meditate, and enjoy breezy evenings.

name: Peacock Lake
description: Serene lake nestled in the eastern forest reserve of the campus, famous for wild peacocks dancing at dawn.
trivia: Listen closely near the water's edge and you'll hear the melodious calls of resident peacocks.

name: Chilkala Kunta Lake
description: The southern natural lake surrounded by rocky Deccan scrubland and seasonal green wetlands.
trivia: Named after the vibrant green parakeets (Chilaka) that flock to roost along its shores.

name: Nallagandla Lake (Garloni Kunta)
description: A tranquil expanse of water on the western boundary of the campus, attracting herons and kingfishers.
trivia: Part of the ancient Deccan natural wetland corridor preserved within the university sanctuary.

name: Kamalavanam Kunta
description: A secluded lotus wetland lake nestled between natural rock ridges and dense forest cover.
trivia: Blooms with delicate pink and white lotus flowers during the post-monsoon season.

name: Virgin Rock
description: A pristine, untouched granitic rock formation surrounded by wild grassland, offering panoramic campus vistas.
trivia: A favorite secret spot for landscape artists, photographers, and nature walkers.

name: High Rock
description: The highest rocky elevation overlooking the central valley of the campus and Gundla Kunta lake.
trivia: Provides a 360-degree sunset panorama across the entire 2,300-acre lush campus.

name: Gate I (North Main Entrance)
description: The main North Gate of the University of Hyderabad on Old Bombay Highway (Gachibowli-Lingampally road).
trivia: The grand welcome portal for incoming freshmen and visitors.

name: Gate II (East Entrance)
description: The Eastern Gate connecting the university toward the Faculty Quarters and Gachibowli tech corridor.
trivia: Offers a direct tree-shaded route into the science schools.

name: South Gate (Gate III - Lingampally / Tellapur Road)
description: The South Gate providing direct connectivity into South Campus, CIS, and South Hostels.
trivia: Leads toward the Tellapur and Nallagandla neighborhoods.

name: Amphitheatre UoH (South Campus)
description: Stepped semicircular stone amphitheatre in South Campus used for open-air debates, acoustic music, and cultural sessions.
trivia: Nestled near the nature slopes overlooking the South Campus hills.

name: Secret Lake
description: A hidden, peaceful lake tucked behind the South Campus woods and nature trails.
trivia: A secluded paradise frequented by migratory birds, peacocks, and curious student explorers.

name: Check Dam UoH
description: Rainwater harvesting reservoir and stone check dam preserving the ecological water table of the campus.
trivia: Creates a lush wetland habitat for dragonflies and water birds during monsoon.

name: Temple (Chinna Gudi)
description: A historic campus temple shrine sheltered under sacred neem and banyan trees.
trivia: A peaceful spiritual sanctuary with ringing brass bells and fragrant incense.

name: Globe Rock
description: A gigantic, perfectly rounded spherical Deccan granite boulder balanced atop the hill slopes.
trivia: Looks like a massive stone globe left behind by ancient geological forces.

name: The Trio Rock
description: Three monolithic granite rocks leaning together in harmonious geological formation in the south-west grasslands.
trivia: A landmark for nature enthusiasts exploring the southern boundary of the university.

name: Volleyball Court (South Campus)
description: Sand volleyball court where hostel residents gather for thrilling evening matches under the floodlights.
trivia: Hosts spirited inter-hostel tournament matches every semester.

name: Gate 3 & IDC Building (Research Complex)
description: Interdisciplinary Research Center and Gate 3 complex in the northeastern sector of South Campus.
trivia: Facilitates collaborative scientific research across cutting-edge frontiers.

name: LH-9 & 10 Mess & Ladies Hostel-9
description: Dining complex and residential block for research scholars in the southernmost quad.
trivia: Known for delicious special weekend dinners and open lawns.
